signal.summary: Arc's superficially strong launch-week DEX activity fails the framework's activity-quality test. Launchpad churn dominated day one, and a fresh Bitquery on-chain investigation found two newly minted look-alike tokens and two wallets generated nearly half of September 20 DEX volume through repeated buy/sell loops. Arc therefore cannot currently be counted as clean discretionary-capital migration or as confirmation for UNI/AERO.

wash_trading_evidence.interpretation: Repeated buy/sell loops within single transactions, with liquidity added and removed around the loops, are not treated as discretionary trading demand. Removing the identified transactions changes the apparent day-over-day direction from +8% to approximately -25%.

signal.institutional_catalyst: Arc remains strategically important: Circle launched public mainnet September 16 with USDC gas, StableFX, Circle Payments Network, Uniswap as a preferred DEX, and tokenized assets including USYC/BUIDL/private credit/cirBTC intended for trading, lending and collateral. Those are future-capability and asset-availability catalysts, not proof of current organic secondary speculation.
signal.rwa_distinction: Tokenized asset availability/TVL is not counted as secondary trading or collateral utilization unless observed. Current launch-week DEX evidence is dominated by memecoin launchpads and contaminated by wash-like loops, so no RWA capital-migration claim is made.
signal.value_capture: Uniswap governance has only a temperature-check proposal to extend protocol-fee collection/burn infrastructure to Arc. It is not treated as active UNI value capture until approved and implemented.
signal.wallet_quality: FAIL for the apparent Arc speculative-volume signal: concentrated activity by two wallets plus volume-bot availability makes headline volume and trader counts highly gameable. No independent selective-wallet cohort was verified.
signal.structural_gate: FAIL for surfaced Arc microcap candidates until contract permissions, LP control, holder/funding concentration, creator behavior and executable liquidity are independently cleared. There is no tradable native ARC token to evaluate.
signal.portfolio_implication: Do not count Arc launch activity as confirmation for existing UNI or AERO positions. Their broader theses remain intact, so no trim is justified solely from this Arc-specific quality failure. Hold all positions.
forward_tests: Recompute Arc DEX activity excluding identified looped/wash-like transactions and launchpad tokens.
Require durable stablecoin transfer/settlement, lending utilization, RWA secondary trading or collateral activity rather than issuance/TVL alone.
Require independently funded repeat wallets with diverse counterparties and no volume-bot or correlated-funding signature.
For UNI, count Arc as direct token value capture only after protocol-fee expansion is approved, implemented and produces measurable burn/holder revenue.
For any Arc microcap, clear all contract/LP/concentration/deployer/sellability gates before surfacing it.
